note.en: Maximum DiT valid-joint normalized RMSE across 2 × 8 fixed-input comparisons. The frozen F16 limit is 0.0009765625; normalized maximum error also has its own gate.

note.en: The mobile W4/F16 DiT failed fixed-input gates across two cases and eight steps. Vision/text/VAE and final rollout latent/RGBA passed. The earlier FP32 result remains passed in its own evidence; full mobile fidelity is incomplete.
note.ja: モバイルW4/F16 DiTは2入力・各8stepの固定入力基準が不合格。Vision/text/VAEと最終latent/RGBAは合格。従来FP32の合格は別の証拠として保持し、モバイル全体は未受入。
